brief:
Israeli occupation forces set up a new checkpoint east of Bethlehem, according to Shehab Wire. The move is part of ongoing military operations in the West Bank region surrounding the Palestinian city.

Details about the checkpoint's specific location and operational procedures remain limited. Residents in the area face potential restrictions on movement and access to nearby communities as a result of the installation.
